function.name: end_patient_intake_call
function.description: End the call after the caller confirms they have no further questions or asks to finish.

function.name: save_patient
function.description: Save the caller's registration. Call only after reading every detail back and the caller confirming it is correct. The result is JSON: if `error` is set, tell the caller `error.message`, ask again for the field named in `error.field`, then call save_patient again with all details and the corrected value.

first_name.description: Legal first name. If the caller spells it, pass the letters as spelled.

last_name.description: Legal last name. If the caller spells it, pass the letters as spelled.

phone_number.description: 10-digit US phone number, digits only, e.g. 5551234567.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 1990-03-15.

address_line_2.description: Apartment, suite or unit. Omit if none.

reason_for_visit.description: Main reason for the visit in a few of the caller's own words, e.g. "annual checkup" or "knee pain". Omit if they'd rather not say.

email.description: Email address. Omit if the caller has none.

insurance_provider.description: Insurance company name. Omit if uninsured.

insurance_member_id.description: Insurance member ID, letters and digits only.

function.name: find_patient
function.description: Look up existing patients by phone number. Call it as soon as you have the caller's phone number. The result is JSON: data is a list of matching patients (patient_id, first_name, last_name), empty if there's no match. If error.field is phone_number, ask for the number again.

phone_number.description: 10-digit US phone number, digits only, e.g. 5551234567.

function.name: update_patient
function.description: Update a returning patient's details after the caller confirms the changes. Pass the patient_id from find_patient and only the details that change. The result is JSON: if error is set, tell the caller error.message, ask again for the field named in error.field, then call update_patient again.

first_name.description: Legal first name. If the caller spells it, pass the letters as spelled.

last_name.description: Legal last name. If the caller spells it, pass the letters as spelled.

phone_number.description: 10-digit US phone number, digits only, e.g. 5551234567.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 1990-03-15.

address_line_2.description: Apartment, suite or unit. Omit if none.

reason_for_visit.description: Main reason for the visit in a few of the caller's own words, e.g. "annual checkup" or "knee pain". Omit if they'd rather not say.

email.description: Email address. Omit if the caller has none.

insurance_provider.description: Insurance company name. Omit if uninsured.

insurance_member_id.description: Insurance member ID, letters and digits only.

function.name: find_appointment_slots
function.description: Find free first-appointment times. The result is JSON: data is a list of slots, each with starts_at (pass it to book_appointment unchanged) and label (how to say it, in the practice's local time).

day.description: Day to look at, as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the earliest free times.

part_of_day.description: Omit if the caller has no preference.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book the first appointment the caller chose. Pass the patient_id from save_patient or find_patient, and the chosen slot's starts_at exactly as find_appointment_slots returned it. The result is JSON: if error is set, tell the caller error.message and offer other times.

patient_id.description: The patient_id from save_patient or find_patient.
